designationHistory.indexText: Piedmont National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1939 as a "combination wildlife and game-management demonstration area" to demonstrate that wildlife could be restored on worn out, eroded lands.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
